name: Reach first captured frames
outcome: Build a Session that captures an application and microphone and polls their independent frames.

name: Select a durable source
outcome: Discover and resolve a source selector while preserving identity and source-generation changes.

name: Record separate stems
outcome: Record independent source stems and inspect finalization outcomes after Session stop.

name: Add an asynchronous operator
outcome: Declare typed ports, implement an operator factory, and route its output.

name: Return generated audio
outcome: Bridge asynchronous PCM output back into the bounded audio lane.

name: Author a connector
outcome: Declare a connector manifest and run its endpoint worker under finite delivery and shutdown policy.

name: Load a compiled extension
outcome: Load a trusted absolute library path and import its registrations transactionally.

name: Bind through C
outcome: Create and operate a Session through ABI handles, status codes, and versioned callbacks.

name: Host an out-of-process worker
outcome: Spawn a sidecar and enforce bounded messages, deadlines, cancellation, and terminal state.

name: Diagnose a running Session
outcome: Correlate events, metrics, trace records, stable error codes, and terminal outcomes.

name: Handle platform permission
outcome: Perform non-prompting observation, own the prompt UX, and treat source opening as authoritative.

name: Inject external PCM
outcome: Acquire bounded buffers, write PCM, and observe source runtime outcomes.

name: Encode and decode a stream
outcome: Configure Opus state and convert audio frames to packets and back.

name: Validate an integration
outcome: Run protocol, ABI, connector, package, and example checks at the frozen source revision.

name: Transcribe captured stems
outcome: Run the repository transcription example and preserve process evidence for its external boundary.
